title: Phishing Awareness
what: Phishing uses deceptive messages to influence people into unsafe actions.
safe_practices: Verify the sender using a trusted channel
action: Report suspicious messages through your approved reporting process.

title: Password Security
what: Strong, unique credentials reduce the impact of password reuse and guessing.
action: Replace a reused password with a unique passphrase.

title: MFA & Passkeys
what: MFA adds an additional authentication factor; phishing-resistant methods provide stronger protection.
action: Review MFA methods on important accounts.

title: Social Engineering
what: Social engineering manipulates people rather than exploiting software directly.
action: Verify unusual requests through a separate trusted channel.

title: Safe Browsing
what: Safe browsing reduces exposure to deceptive links and untrusted downloads.
action: Update your primary browser and review extensions.

title: Software Updates
what: Keeping operating systems, applications, browsers, and security tools updated helps reduce exposure to known security weaknesses.
action: Check one important device or application for pending security updates.

title: Ransomware Awareness
what: Ransomware can disrupt services and may involve data theft or extortion.
action: Confirm important backups exist and are recoverable.

title: USB & Removable Media Safety
what: Untrusted removable media can introduce security and data-exposure risks.
safe_practices: Protect sensitive data stored on removable media
action: Review your organization's approved removable-media policy.

title: Data Privacy
what: Data minimization limits the impact of accidental exposure.
action: Review one cloud folder or shared document for unnecessary access.

title: Secure Wi-Fi
what: Secure network practices reduce the risk of unauthorized access and data exposure.
safe_practices: Avoid sensitive activity on unknown networks
action: Review the security settings of your primary Wi-Fi network.

title: Mobile Security
what: Mobile security protects accounts, personal data, applications, and communications on smartphones and tablets.
action: Review installed applications and remove anything unnecessary or untrusted.

title: Remote Work Security
what: Secure remote-work practices help protect organizational accounts, devices, and information outside the office.
action: Review the security settings and approved access methods for your remote-work setup.

title: Cloud Account Security
what: Cloud account security focuses on protecting identities, permissions, data, and connected services.
action: Review active sessions and connected applications on an important cloud account.

title: Incident Reporting
what: Fast reporting helps defenders investigate suspicious events before they grow.
action: Know the approved security reporting channel.

title: AI-Enabled Scam Awareness
what: AI can make scam messages more convincing, so context and verification remain important.
safe_practices: Do not rely only on writing quality
action: Discuss one independent verification method with your team.
